# Example halls

Each link below opens the [live demo](https://datahall-eight.vercel.app/) with a ready-made hall: the layout travels in the URL hash, so nothing is sent to a server and every hall can be edited, exported or broken on purpose once it is open. The halls are built from the app's own presets and goal generator, and the numbers come from the same capacity model the page uses.

The app is in English by default. Put `?lang=zh` before the `#` to open a hall with the Simplified Chinese interface.

## Small teaching hall

Eight GB200 racks with just enough power, cooling and network to run on a 2 MW feed. The hall the tutorial builds.

[Open this hall](https://datahall-eight.vercel.app/#layout=1,2,gb200:4.3-5.3-6.3-7.3-8.3-9.3-10.3-11.3,cdu:4.5-5.5,ib:6.5-7.5,rpp:8.5-9.5,crah:10.5-11.5)

Powers on · 576 GPUs · 1.05 MW IT load · PUE 1.21 · 8 GPU racks and 8 support units · 2 MW feed · 1 phase · not N+1

## N+1 design

Three of every facility, so no single CDU, power panel, cooler or switch rack failure stops the hall. Try the failure drill.

[Open this hall](https://datahall-eight.vercel.app/#layout=1,2,gb200:4.3-5.3-6.3-7.3-8.3-9.3-10.3-11.3,cdu:2.5-6.5-10.5,rpp:3.5-7.5-11.5,ib:4.5-8.5-12.5,crah:5.5-9.5-13.5)

Powers on · 576 GPUs · 1.07 MW IT load · PUE 1.23 · 8 GPU racks and 12 support units · 2 MW feed · 1 phase · N+1

## Two-phase growth plan

Phase 1 runs; phase 2 doubles the racks and brings the support it needs. Both phases pass.

[Open this hall](https://datahall-eight.vercel.app/#layout=3,2,gb200:6.4-7.4-8.4-9.4-12.3-13.3-14.3-15.3,rpp:7.3-9.5,cdu:8.3-10.4,ib:7.5-13.2,crah:8.5-14.2,@2:12.3-13.3-14.3-15.3-9.5-10.4-13.2-14.2)

Powers on · 576 GPUs · 1.05 MW IT load · PUE 1.21 · 8 GPU racks and 8 support units · 2 MW feed · 2 phases · not N+1
